_comment: Run ids in results/experiments.db that must never appear in an analysis.
experiments/analyze.py reads this file by default and drops these rows.
The rows themselves are NEVER deleted -- a discarded run stays on record,
and the reason it was discarded is part of the record. Override with
--include-invalidated only to inspect what was thrown away.

excluded.reason: Two superseded E2 attempts. The first ran without continuous background traffic, so the network was under-loaded relative to the regime the model was trained in. The second was CPU-starved by wedged multipass clients on the host, and because the arms run sequentially the starvation covered the entire B1 baseline arm and none of P2 -- confounding host CPU with the system under test. See docs/limitations.md.
